When you use Athena to read an encrypted table, Athena uses the encryption options specified for the table data, not the encryption option for the query results. You should also consider compression when choosing data formats. Efficient compression can help queries run faster and reduce cost. Similarly to compression, this can also lead to reductions in query time. Often, you need to choose between compression or splittable formats because applying both is currently not well supported for analytics workloads.
